package_manager.name: npm
package_manager.install_rule: CI uses npm ci from committed lockfile. Required peer dependencies are direct dependencies; unused optional peer ecosystems must not be auto-added solely for optional SDK integrations.
package_manager.pin_rule: Initial direct dependencies use exact versions; upgrades require PR evidence rather than floating latest.

circle_cli.reason_outside_lockfile: Developer/J0 tool only; broad x402/Solana tooling is not part of application runtime.

platform_primitives: node:crypto for hash/sign/verify and key operations
strict decimal-string to bigint parser for authoritative USDC 6-decimal atomic units
Next route handlers instead of Express/Fastify
Postgres SQL/RPC functions for atomic authority transitions
Postgres durable outbox/reservation lease instead of a separate queue platform
small internal structured/redacting logger instead of a telemetry framework

circle_p0_decision.reason: P0 requires one server-side Arc Testnet wallet/USDC execution path. Direct DCW SDK supports ARC-TESTNET without App Kit cross-chain/swap breadth.
circle_p0_decision.revisit_condition: Only if J0/J2 proves the direct DCW path cannot satisfy required Arc execution/status/idempotency behavior.

adopt: NVIDIA Build as P0 hosted inference provider
nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b as pinned P0 Finance Agent model
ai_p0_decision.rule: If the model/provider fails the eval contract, change the model/adapter before adding orchestration breadth.

contingency.rule: No automatic router or silent fallback. Any contingency use starts a new AgentRun with explicit provider/model/config identity and must satisfy the frozen eval contract.

executable_config.retry_policy: At most one retry for a pre-response transient transport/5xx failure. Never silently switch provider/model. Partial/ambiguous response, schema failure, tool failure or capability mismatch ends the AgentRun fail-closed as HOLD/ESCALATE.
executable_config.structured_output: Final PAY/HOLD/ESCALATE object must validate against the application-owned Zod schema; invalid or incomplete output fails closed.
executable_config.tool_mode: Static code-defined typed READ/ANALYZE/PROPOSE allowlist only; no approval, signing, payment, shell, arbitrary SQL/HTTP or unrestricted MCP capability.
executable_config.capability_smoke: Before J1 acceptance, prove the pinned endpoint/model can return the required structured final output and execute only an allowed typed skill under the frozen manifest. Failure blocks J1 acceptance.
executable_config.runtime_hash_rule: Persist SHA-256 of the exact executable provider/model request configuration with every AgentRun; any config change starts a new config version and reruns the frozen eval contract.

data_p0_decision.adopt: Supabase/Postgres + SQL migrations + RLS/Auth/RPC as needed
data_p0_decision.atomicity_rule: Money/authority state transitions requiring atomicity are implemented as database functions/transactions, not client-side multi-call sequences.

ui_p0_decision.revisit_condition: Only if J3 reveals a concrete accessibility/reliability blocker before feature freeze at end of Day 11.

crypto_numeric.crypto: Node standard cryptography; no custom cryptographic primitive
crypto_numeric.money: USDC authoritative value is bigint atomic units derived from strict decimal-string parsing; binary float is never authoritative.

broad_circle_candidate.interpretation: Rejected for P0 because cross-chain/Solana/Ethers/provider breadth is unnecessary for the one-chain proof; this is not a blanket judgment on package security.

adopted_candidate.interpretation: Point-in-time lockfile survey only; CI dependency review remains mandatory.

survey_evidence.local_action: Do not change global SWD Node. Bootstrap Tameion with project-scoped Node 24.

supply_chain_policy: exact direct dependency pins at bootstrap
dependency tree/audit evidence on PR and release
weekly Dependabot for npm and GitHub Actions
no automatic merge for financial/runtime provider dependencies
Circle/Supabase/Next/AI/canonicalization dependency updates run targeted financial/adversarial/eval regressions
no dependency may add a new financial authority path
Tameion third-party GitHub Actions are pinned by full immutable commit SHA, not moving major/minor tags
Gitleaks is the selected P0 secret scanner; exact release/checksum or immutable action SHA is recorded at J0 bootstrap

mcp_policy.developer_control_plane: Allowed for engineering/governance workflows such as GitHub, documentation/reference retrieval, repository inspection and other explicitly authorized developer tooling.
mcp_policy.runtime_financial_path: Prohibited for P0 as a generic agent-to-money router. Finance Agent -> typed application service -> Safety Kernel -> signed PAE -> Execution Worker remains the only money authority path.
mcp_policy.secrets: Developer MCP/tools must not be given wallet private keys, PAE signing secrets or production/provider credentials unless a future narrowly scoped tool is explicitly threat-modeled and approved.
mcp_policy.scope: MCP use for development does not become an application runtime dependency and does not grant financial authority.

rag_policy.p0_retrieval: Use deterministic scoped evidence IDs/allowlisted context linked to the obligation.
rag_policy.future_trigger: Reconsider only when long contracts/policies/vendor history/regulatory corpora create a demonstrated retrieval need; then require provenance, tenant isolation, freshness and prompt-injection evals.

secret_scanner.name: Gitleaks
secret_scanner.purpose: blocking repository secret scan in local/CI/release gates
secret_scanner.pin_rule: J0 bootstrap records one exact Gitleaks release/version and checksum or immutable action commit; upgrades require reviewed PR evidence
secret_scanner.config_rule: scanner configuration is committed and versioned with the Tameion product repository

pii_publication_scan.scope: deterministic public-repository/demo-artifact checks for known real names, emails, account/wallet/source identifiers and prohibited fixture markers
pii_publication_scan.claim_limit: This is a publication guard, not a DLP certification or guarantee of comprehensive PII detection.

ci_security_tooling.github_actions_pin_rule: Every third-party GitHub Action in the Tameion product repository uses a full immutable commit SHA in uses:. A human-readable release tag/version may appear only as a comment; moving major tags such as @v4 are not sufficient for release identity.

agent_runtime_policy.p0_provider_adapter: OpenAI SDK compatible adapter targeting NVIDIA Build
defer: business workflow engine inside money path
agent_runtime_policy.rule: Prefer a small typed application-owned loop. Add orchestration framework breadth only for a concrete post-P0 blocker.
agent_runtime_policy.p0_email_connector: No live Gmail/Outlook connector dependency. P0 consumes normalized uploaded/redacted source evidence; live mailbox OAuth remains post-P0 unless a concrete blocker is proven.
agent_runtime_policy.p0_model_fallback: No silent fallback. OpenRouter is contingency-only and requires a new explicitly recorded AgentRun.
agent_runtime_policy.p0_config_change_rule: Any change to provider/model/endpoint/reasoning/sampling/output-token limit/timeout-retry/structured-output/tool-mode creates a new config version and requires the frozen eval contract before acceptance.
